title.zh: 延续者从其外得到供给
title.en: A continuing family is fed from beyond

statement.zh: 延续者从其外得到供给，这是汲入律的输送形式。在可判定相等之下，从其外得到供给恰是该步不内向；必要的是得到供给，不必有哪个来源条件复现。
statement.en: A continuing family is fed from beyond, the conveyance form of the draw-in laws. With equality decided, being fed from beyond is exactly a step that is not inward; being fed is needed, and no source condition need recur.

laws.zh: 跨从 t 起的一步，一个参与的形成从 c 取用并向 d 给予时，有东西从 c 输送到 d；有东西从家族之外的条件输送入它的某个成员时，家族在该步从其外得到供给。
laws.en: Across the step from t, something is conveyed from c to d when a formation taking part takes from c and gives to d; a family is fed from beyond across the step when something is conveyed from a condition outside it into one of its members.

laws.zh: 家族在某步从其外得到供给时，该步不内向；相等可判定时，没有从其外得到供给的一步是内向的，所以二者恰相反，驳倒“从某步起每步都内向”的，也驳倒“从某步起都没有东西从其外输送入”。
laws.en: A step at which the family is fed from beyond is not inward; with equality decided, a step at which it is not fed from beyond is inward, so the two are exact opposites, and whatever refutes ‘inward at every step from some step on’ refutes ‘fed from nothing beyond from some step on’.

laws.zh: 于是由汲入律，在平衡与耗散之下，从某步起被围住的、不重复的有限家族，若在任意晚的步有形成从它取用，或它的成员在任意晚的步上升，就不能从某步起都没有东西从其外输送入。
laws.en: So, by the draw-in laws, under balance and dissipation a finite family without repetition, enclosed around from some step on, cannot from any step on be fed from nothing beyond it, whether formations take from it at arbitrarily late steps or its members rise at arbitrarily late steps.

laws.zh: 以一类关系项读，体现的成员在任意晚的步生起时，同样成立。
laws.en: Read with one kind of relatum, the same holds where embodied members arise at arbitrarily late steps.

laws.zh: 取用与上升的两条规律在任一世界中成立，局部条件写在规律之内：从某步起，该家族平衡、被围住，且每步闭合的不重复家族被耗散；处处平衡与耗散之下的形式是它们的推论。
laws.en: The two laws for taking and rising hold in every world with the local condition inside the law: from some step on, the family balanced on and enclosed around, and every family without repetition closed across each step dissipated on; the forms under balance and dissipation everywhere are their corollaries.

laws.zh: 必要的是得到供给，不必有哪个来源条件复现：在平衡、耗散、吃者每步取用的 Lone 中，池每步都从其外得到供给，而每份燃料只在它自己的那一步被输送出；输送的始终是同一个源。
laws.en: Being fed is needed, and no source condition need recur: in Lone, balanced and dissipative with an eater taking at every step, the pool is fed from beyond at every step while each fuel is conveyed from at its own step only; the one source does all the conveying.

hypotheses.zh: 平衡（Flow.Balances）与耗散（Flow.Dissipative）：同 no-finite-part-bears-taking，是表示中的物理前提，各有满足与不满足它的世界。
hypotheses.en: Balance (Flow.Balances) and dissipation (Flow.Dissipative): as in no-finite-part-bears-taking, physical premises of the representation, each met by some worlds and not by others.

hypotheses.zh: 家族不重复（Distinct），从某步起被围住（Around）；取用复现、成员上升复现或体现成员生起复现，三者各为一条定理的假设。
hypotheses.en: The family is without repetition (Distinct) and enclosed around from some step on (Around); recurring taking, recurring rising and recurring embodied arising are each the hypothesis of one theorem.

hypotheses.zh: 相等可判定：inward_of_not_fed 及由它推出的定理需要它，是表示的逻辑承诺，同 Flow.Enclosed.around。
hypotheses.en: Decided equality: inward_of_not_fed and the theorems drawn from it need it, a logical commitment of the representation, as in Flow.Enclosed.around.

hypotheses.zh: 构造性的形式：结论是“不能从某步起都没有东西从其外输送入”，不给出输送入发生的某一步；由它得出“在任意晚的步得到供给”需要全知。
hypotheses.en: The constructive form: the conclusion is that the family cannot from any step on be fed from nothing beyond it; it exhibits no step at which it is fed, and reading it as ‘fed at arbitrarily late steps’ needs omniscience.

hypotheses.zh: 离散步、自然数的量与有限家族。
hypotheses.en: Discrete steps, natural-number amounts and finite families.

does_not_show.zh: 只说必须计入其外，不说应当。
does_not_show.en: Says only that what lies beyond must be counted, not that it ought to be.

does_not_show.zh: 不说输送来自哪个形成，也不说来源是否活着。
does_not_show.en: Says neither which formation conveys nor whether the source is living.

detail.zh: 不必有哪个来源条件复现：Lone 中池每步都从其外得到供给，而每份燃料只在它自己的那一步被输送出（Lone.fed_not_recurring）；输送的始终是同一个源，所以这不说明特定的来源形成不必要。
detail.en: No source condition need recur: in Lone the pool is fed from beyond at every step while each fuel is conveyed from at its own step only (Lone.fed_not_recurring); the one source does all the conveying, so this does not show that no particular source formation is needed.

detail.zh: 也不必有哪个来源形成复现：Successive 中每步有它自己的源，只在那一步在场并活跃，燃烧那一步的燃料，向池给予一份；吃者每步从池取用一份。流平衡、耗散，只有活跃的形成给予；池每步从其外得到供给，而没有哪个来源形成在两步参与，也没有哪个在两步活跃（Successive.relay，由 Successive.takes_part_once 推出）。每个源仍在它自己的那一步被需要：去掉它，那一步不被供给。
detail.en: No source formation need recur either: in Successive each step has its own source, present and active at that step only, which burns that step's fuel and gives the pool one unit; the eater takes one unit from the pool at every step. The flow balances, is dissipative and only active formations give; the pool is fed from beyond at every step, while no source formation takes part at two steps and none is active at two (Successive.relay, from Successive.takes_part_once). Each source is still needed at its own step: without it that step is not fed.

detail.zh: 没有耗散时封闭的家族可以永远生成（Recycle），所以耗散是必要的前提；以喷洒交换的汇使耗散空成立时，家族开放而什么都不输送入（SprayShuttle，见 no-finite-part-bears-taking）。
detail.en: Without dissipation a closed family can generate forever (Recycle), so dissipation is a needed premise; with a sink exchanging with ever new relata dissipation holds vacuously and the family opens while nothing flows into it (SprayShuttle, see no-finite-part-bears-taking).

next_delta.zh: 给出输送来自活着的来源时的读法；可移除的形式，即同一世界去掉一个来源形成后仍每步得到供给（去掉形成会改变水平，所以那是另一个流，以世界为单位的形式是它的位置）；整段与以世界为单位的形式。输送是否算作已形成的关系由 Ren 判断。
next_delta.en: Read the case where what is conveyed comes from a living source; give the removable form, the same world still fed at every step with one source formation taken away (that is another flow, since taking a formation away changes the levels; the world-level form is its place); give whole-run and world-level forms. Whether conveyance counts as a formed relation is Ren's to judge.

correspondence.zh: Ren 的提议说：“the pure "self" is an illusion, where only when outside exists, there is the system, if the system depends on external resources”。汲入律（no-finite-part-bears-taking、generation-is-replenishment）已说：被围住时，有形成向家族给予并从其外取用。本结果把同一规律陈述为从外输送入家族，并在可判定相等之下证明两种形式等价：输送的形式只加可判定相等，不丢失内容。作者的读法（AI 论证）：延续的自我与其外之物一起延续；边界是形成的、实在的，而在其内延续的东西跨边界得到供给。这是动力学，不是伦理：它说一个延续者必须计入什么，不说它应当计入。Lone 说明必要的是得到供给，不必有哪个来源条件复现；它没有说明不需要特定的来源形成：输送的始终是同一个源。
correspondence.en: Ren's proposal says: “the pure "self" is an illusion, where only when outside exists, there is the system, if the system depends on external resources”. The draw-in laws (no-finite-part-bears-taking, generation-is-replenishment) said that, enclosed around, some formation gives to the family and takes from beyond it. This result states the same law as conveyance into the family from beyond and shows the two forms equivalent with equality decided: the conveyance form adds only decided equality and loses nothing. The author's reading (an AI argument): a self that continues does so together with what lies beyond it; the boundary is formed and real, while what continues within it is fed across it. This is dynamics, not ethics: it says what a continuing formation must count, not that it ought to count it. Lone shows that being fed is needed and no source condition need recur; it does not show that no particular source formation is needed, since the one source does all the conveying.

detail.zh: 复用 taking_draws_in、Inward、Around、Distinct 与 Lone；fed_from_beyond 由 taking_draws_in 经 fed_of_not_inward 推出。
detail.en: Reuses taking_draws_in, Inward, Around, Distinct and Lone; fed_from_beyond follows from taking_draws_in through fed_of_not_inward.

output.zh: 在耗散之下，取用复现、从某步起被围住的有限家族汲入：不是从某步起每步都内向。
output.en: Under dissipation a finite family from which taking recurs, enclosed around from some step on, draws in: it is not inward at every step from some step on.

input.zh: 在可判定相等之下，不内向恰是从其外得到供给。
input.en: With equality decided, not being inward is exactly being fed from beyond.

conditions.zh: 平衡；耗散；不重复；被围住；取用复现；可判定相等。
conditions.en: Balance; dissipation; no repetition; enclosure around; recurring taking; decided equality.

detail.zh: 复用 rising_draws_in 与 Web.generation_draws_in，得到上升与体现生起的输送形式。
detail.en: Reuses rising_draws_in and Web.generation_draws_in for the conveyance forms of rising and embodied arising.

output.zh: 上升或体现生起复现的有限家族，被围住时汲入。
output.en: A finite family in which rising or embodied arising recurs, enclosed around, draws in.

input.zh: 它不能从某步起都没有东西从其外输送入。
input.en: It cannot from any step on be fed from nothing beyond it.

conditions.zh: 平衡；耗散；不重复；被围住；可判定相等；生起的形式还需一类读法与体现。
conditions.en: Balance; dissipation; no repetition; enclosure around; decided equality; the arising form also needs the one-kind reading and embodiment.

detail.zh: 局部规律只在所用的步与家族上假定 laws-of-one-step 的 Flow.BalancesOn；全局前提给出它，所以原定理是推论。
detail.en: The local laws assume Flow.BalancesOn of laws-of-one-step only at the steps and families they use; the global premises give it, so the original theorems are corollaries.

output.zh: 跨一步对一个有限家族的平衡（Flow.BalancesOn）与下降（Flow.RunsDown）。
output.en: Balance on a finite family across one step (Flow.BalancesOn) and running down (Flow.RunsDown).

input.zh: 本记录的局部规律在所用各步对所用家族假定它。
input.en: This record's local laws assume it at the families and steps they use.

detail.zh: 被围住所立者时交换归于静止；本结果说的是被围住一个家族时，延续需要从其外输送入。
detail.en: Enclosed around what stands, exchange comes to rest; this result says that, enclosed around a family, continuation needs conveyance from beyond it.

detail.zh: 以输送为 related 时，延续家族的区域不是关系的切口。
detail.en: With conveyance read as related, a continuing family's region is no cut in the relations.
